title: Starship's Orbital Success Sparks 'Crisis' Among Rivals Over Rocket Shortage
detail: Starship's progress toward orbital success is spurring a crisis among Starlink competitors and rival launch operators over a looming rocket shortage and launch capacity gap. Rival operators are warning of reduced market access as SpaceX's increasing launch cadence and cost advantages widen, squeezing competitors' ability to secure launch slots at competitive prices.
